supplements.title: Dual-ligand-modified cantharidin nanoparticles for the treatment of hepatocellular carcinoma via the inhibition of Ephb4.
supplements.summary: Dual-targeting nanoparticles delivering cantharidin effectively treat hepatocellular carcinoma by blocking EphB4, reducing toxicity compared to existing therapies.

supplements.title: Neuroprotective effects of cinnamaldehyde and naltrexone on morphine-induced hippocampal neurotoxicity: Behavioral, biochemical, ultrastructural evaluations.
supplements.summary: Cinnamaldehyde and naltrexone protect brain cells from morphine-induced cognitive damage through antioxidant and anti-inflammatory mechanisms.

supplements.title: Polyunsaturated fatty acid-functionalized fucoidan nanoparticles targeting and regulating 'tumor ecosystem' for metastatic cancer therapy.
supplements.summary: New nanoparticles combining fatty acids and cancer drug effectively target and kill tumor cells while reducing metastasis.

supplements.title: Selective Anticancer Effects of Portulaca grandiflora via Apoptosis and NF-κB Pathway Modulation in MDA-MB-231 Cells.
supplements.summary: Portulaca grandiflora plant extract kills triple-negative breast cancer cells by triggering apoptosis and blocking NF-κB survival signals.

supplements.title: Anti-osteoporotic potential of Lawsonia inermis leaf extract: integration of network pharmacology, molecular docking, and experimental validation in ovariectomized rats.
supplements.summary: Lawsonia inermis leaf extract prevents bone loss in postmenopausal osteoporosis by reducing inflammation and strengthening bone through natural compounds.

supplements.title: RT-qPCR-based transcriptional profiling of the effects of tarantula logoplex on inflammatory, oxidative stress and apoptosis pathways in remote organs in experimental lower extremity ischemia-reperfusion injury.
supplements.summary: Tarantula extract protected the liver, heart, and kidneys from damage caused by lower limb blood flow loss and restoration.

supplements.title: Integrated Experimental and In-Silico Analysis Indicates Melittin as a Modulator of IL-37a-Associated Networks in Neuroblastoma.
supplements.summary: Melittin, a bee venom peptide, kills neuroblastoma cells and boosts anti-inflammatory IL-37a signaling while suppressing pro-inflammatory pathways.

supplements.title: Oral microbiota member Neisseria elongata exosomes-Cassia fistula association targets PTEN/AKT/IL10/IL1β/BAX/BCL-2 signaling pathway in pancreatic cancer immunotherapy.
supplements.summary: Bacterial exosomes combined with plant extract killed pancreatic cancer cells by triggering apoptosis and boosting immune response.

supplements.title: Harmane induces apoptosis through RRM2B and suppresses colorectal cancer progression.
supplements.summary: Harmane, a natural compound, kills colorectal cancer cells by activating RRM2B and altering gut bacteria to suppress tumor growth.

supplements.title: Toward Nano-Nutritional Medicine: A Remotely Activated Trans-Vaccenic Acid-Based Lipid Nanoparticles for Enhancing Immune Checkpoint Blockade Therapy.
supplements.summary: Nanoparticles containing a nutrient (trans-vaccenic acid) activated by light enhance immune therapy effectiveness against multiple cancer types.

supplements.title: Effects of different types of physical exercise on postoperative mental health in cancer patients.
supplements.summary: Physical exercise after cancer surgery significantly improves mental health, with yoga most effective for anxiety and aerobic exercise best for quality of life.

supplements.title: Exercise and Mind-Body Interventions for Cancer-Related Fatigue: A Network Meta-Analysis With Exploratory Moderator Analyses.
supplements.summary: Exercise and mind-body interventions effectively reduce cancer-related fatigue, with benefits varying based on patient characteristics and treatment dose.

supplements.title: RETRACTED: Kim et al. The p53-Driven Anticancer Effect of Ribes fasciculatum Extract on AGS Gastric Cancer Cells. Life 2022, 12, 303.
supplements.summary: This article about Ribes fasciculatum extract's effects on gastric cancer has been retracted and is no longer valid research.

supplements.title: Endurance exercise elicits temporal and sexual dimorphic multi-omics remodeling of liver metabolism revealed by MoTrPAC.
supplements.summary: Endurance exercise remodels liver metabolism differently in males and females, reducing fibrosis risk through sex-specific metabolic pathways.

supplements.title: Hedyotis diffusa Willd-Scutellaria barbata D.Don Suppresses Colorectal Cancer Liver Metastasis by Targeting hsa_circ_0039933-Mediated Epithelial-Mesenchymal Transition.
supplements.summary: A traditional Chinese herbal combination suppresses colorectal cancer liver spread by blocking a specific circular RNA that drives cancer cell migration.

off_label.title: CA7 overexpression enhances the anti-tumor effects of propofol in colorectal cancer via JAK2/STAT3 pathway.
off_label.summary: CA7 protein boosts propofol's cancer-fighting effects in colorectal cancer by blocking a specific growth pathway.

off_label.title: Enhancing Continence Recovery After Robot-Assisted Radical Prostatectomy: A Novel Combined Approach Using Testosterone Therapy and Magnetic Stimulation.
off_label.summary: Testosterone therapy combined with magnetic stimulation helps prostate cancer patients recover bladder control after robotic surgery.

off_label.title: Cannabinoids and opioid consumption in cancer pain: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
off_label.summary: Cannabinoids combined with opioids may reduce the amount of opioids needed to manage cancer pain, though more research is required.

off_label.title: Rapamycin Targets Cancer Stem Cells to Decrease Cisplatin Resistance in a Head and Neck Cancer Mouse Xenograft Model.
off_label.summary: Rapamycin drug combined with cisplatin reduces resistant cancer stem cells in head and neck cancer.

off_label.title: Targeting Lactate-Driven Stromal Autophagy via MCT1 Disrupts the Immunosuppressive Niche and Sensitizes Pancreatic Cancer to PD-1 Blockade.
off_label.summary: Blocking lactate transport in pancreatic cancer tumors restores immune function and enhances PD-1 immunotherapy effectiveness.

off_label.title: Machine learning-guided drug repurposing for EGFR inhibition using scaffold-split validation, docking, and molecular dynamics.
off_label.summary: Researchers used machine learning and computer modeling to identify existing drugs that could effectively target drug-resistant lung cancer mutations.

off_label.title: The Efficacy of Dexamethasone Versus N-Acetylcysteine in Prevention of Post-Embolization Syndrome in Hepatocellular Carcinoma Patients: A Multicenter Randomized, Double-Blind, Double-Dummy, Non-Inferiority Trial.
off_label.summary: Dexamethasone and N-acetylcysteine are equally effective at preventing side effects after liver cancer embolization treatment.

off_label.title: A Self-Cascade Nanozyme of Metformin-Stabilized Amorphous Iron Oxide With Ultrahigh Fe(II) for Potent Tumor Therapy at Ultralow Dose.
off_label.summary: Low-dose iron oxide nanoparticles generate hydrogen peroxide to trigger cancer cell death effectively, even in oxygen-poor tumors.

off_label.title: A Multicenter, Prospective, Randomized, Open-label Phase Ib/II Study of Celecoxib Plus Pembrolizumab and Gemcitabine/Cisplatin Versus Pembrolizumab and Gemcitabine/Cisplatin in Patients With CK5/6-High Unresectable Locally Advanced or Metastatic Intrahepatic Cholangiocarcinoma
off_label.summary: Adding celecoxib to standard immunotherapy and chemotherapy may improve outcomes in advanced intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma patients with high CK5/6 levels.

off_label.title: Gut microbial metabolism of Flutamide attenuates its therapeutic efficacy against prostate cancer.
off_label.summary: Gut bacteria break down prostate cancer drug Flutamide into inactive compounds, reducing its effectiveness and explaining treatment resistance.

off_label.title: Screening of putative inhibitors for cytotoxin VacA from Helicobacter pylori.
off_label.summary: Researchers identified seven promising drug candidates that block VacA, a toxin from H. pylori bacteria linked to gastric cancer development.

off_label.title: Targeting the Calcineurin Homologous Protein 1 (CHP1)-Transmembrane Protein 87A (TMEM87A) mechanosensing complex: a druggable vulnerability in metastatic ovarian cancer.
off_label.summary: Researchers identified a protein complex in ovarian cancer cells that controls metastasis, and found that sodium gluconate drug treatment blocks it effectively.

off_label.title: DeepPurpose based deep learning approach for drug repurposing targeting VEGFR2 in hepatocellular carcinoma.
off_label.summary: Researchers used artificial intelligence to identify existing drugs that could treat liver cancer by targeting VEGFR2, finding three promising candidates including APY-29.

off_label.title: Non-Genetic Mechanisms of Fractional Resistance to Abemaciclib in Dedifferentiated Liposarcoma.
off_label.summary: Dedifferentiated liposarcoma cells escape abemaciclib therapy through CDK2 activation, suggesting combining CDK2 inhibitors could improve treatment outcomes.

off_label.title: Fenofibrate attenuates hyperhomocysteinemia-potentiated thrombosis by restoring platelet fatty acid β-oxidation.
off_label.summary: Fenofibrate restores a metabolic pathway in platelets, reducing dangerous blood clots caused by high homocysteine levels.

biomarkers.title: Dual-ligand-modified cantharidin nanoparticles for the treatment of hepatocellular carcinoma via the inhibition of Ephb4.
biomarkers.summary: Dual-targeting nanoparticles delivering cantharidin effectively treat hepatocellular carcinoma by blocking EphB4, reducing toxicity compared to existing therapies.

biomarkers.title: The tumor microenvironment in triple negative breast cancer and a strategy to improve responses to immunotherapy using cryoablation and immunostimulants.
biomarkers.summary: Combining cryoablation with immunotherapy drugs could improve treatment responses in aggressive triple-negative breast cancer by boosting immune system activation.

biomarkers.title: Neoplastic CD3⁺ B cells remodel the DLBCL tumor microenvironment via single-cell and spatial transcriptomics.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers mapped DLBCL tumors at high detail using multiple imaging techniques to understand how cancer cells reshape their surrounding environment.

biomarkers.title: Genetic variants of the transporter SLC22A4 affect the abundance and survival of Fusobacterium nucleatum in colorectal cancer.
biomarkers.summary: A genetic variant in the SLC22A4 transporter allows cancer cells to tolerate more cancer-promoting bacteria, increasing colorectal cancer risk.

biomarkers.title: RET fusion partners dictate oncogenic potential in undifferentiated spindle cell sarcomas.
biomarkers.summary: Different RET fusion partners in spindle cell sarcomas determine how aggressive the cancer becomes, enabling better treatment targeting.

biomarkers.title: The regulatory roles of non-coding RNAs in aerobic glycolysis and therapeutic potential in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma.
biomarkers.summary: Non-coding RNAs control sugar metabolism in pancreatic cancer cells, offering potential new treatment targets for this deadly disease.

biomarkers.title: CA7 overexpression enhances the anti-tumor effects of propofol in colorectal cancer via JAK2/STAT3 pathway.
biomarkers.summary: CA7 protein boosts propofol's cancer-fighting effects in colorectal cancer by blocking a specific growth pathway.

biomarkers.title: EpCAM promotes metastasis-associated phenotypes in Ewing sarcoma-family tumor cells by activating the PI3K/AKT signaling pathway.
biomarkers.summary: EpCAM protein drives Ewing sarcoma cancer cells to spread by activating a specific cellular growth pathway.

biomarkers.title: Sweet syndrome with reactive lymphadenopathy mimicking metastatic disease in an SDHB-mutated abdominal paraganglioma.
biomarkers.summary: Sweet syndrome resolved after surgical removal of an SDHB-mutated abdominal paraganglioma, confirming paraneoplastic disease association.

biomarkers.title: Hyperthyroidism, acromegaly, and hyperprolactinemia in a patient with a mature plurihormonal PIT-1 lineage adenoma.
biomarkers.summary: A pituitary tumor secreting multiple hormones was successfully removed, resolving thyroid and prolactin problems, though growth hormone levels required ongoing monitoring.

biomarkers.title: Metabolic remodeling by circular RNAs in gastric tumorigenesis: From mechanisms to biomarker discovery (Review).
biomarkers.summary: Circular RNAs drive metabolic changes that fuel gastric cancer growth and may serve as diagnostic markers for the disease.

biomarkers.title: Emerging agents that target signaling pathways in cancer fibroblast cells (Review).
biomarkers.summary: Small molecule drugs targeting signaling pathways in cancer-associated fibroblasts show promise for inhibiting tumor growth and metastasis.

biomarkers.title: Growth hormone-secreting adenoma with lack of retinoblastoma protein expression.
biomarkers.summary: A patient with a germline RB1 gene mutation developed a growth hormone-secreting pituitary adenoma lacking Rb protein expression.

biomarkers.title: Functioning gonadotroph macroadenoma associated with multiple endocrine neoplasia type 1.
biomarkers.summary: A rare functioning gonadotroph pituitary tumor in MEN1 syndrome caused abnormal bleeding and was treated with surgery, though residual disease progressed.

biomarkers.title: Hydrogel Microbead-Confined Nanozyme-SERS Sensor for Robust Detection of Hydrogen Peroxide in Complex Biological Systems.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers developed a hydrogel-nanozyme sensor that reliably detects hydrogen peroxide, an inflammation marker, in complex biological environments.

trials.title: The tumor microenvironment in triple negative breast cancer and a strategy to improve responses to immunotherapy using cryoablation and immunostimulants.
trials.summary: Combining cryoablation with immunotherapy drugs could improve treatment responses in aggressive triple-negative breast cancer by boosting immune system activation.

trials.title: [Clinical characterization and genetic analysis of two Chinese pedigrees affected with Familial adenomatous polyposis caused by variants of MUTYH gene].
trials.summary: Researchers identified two Chinese families with colon cancer syndrome caused by genetic MUTYH mutations, expanding understanding of this hereditary condition.

trials.title: Durvalumab in Combination With Neoadjuvant Chemotherapy in Early Triple-Negative Breast Cancer: Long-Term Analysis From the GeparNuevo Trial.
trials.summary: Adding durvalumab to chemotherapy improved long-term survival in early triple-negative breast cancer patients, regardless of complete tumor response.

trials.title: Boosting long-term immunity with bioengineered nanovaccines.
trials.summary: Bioengineered nanovaccines using advanced materials deliver sustained immunity against cancer and infectious diseases through controlled antigen release.

trials.title: Narrowing of glioma vascular caliber via chronic VEGFR2 blockade improves the uniformity of focused ultrasound-mediated small molecule drug delivery.
trials.summary: Blocking a tumor growth protein before focused ultrasound treatment helps glioblastoma drugs reach previously inaccessible tumor regions more uniformly.

trials.title: Delivery routes and circular mRNA vaccine architecture synergistically shape in vivo immune profiles.
trials.summary: Circular RNA vaccine effectiveness depends on both delivery route and molecular design working together to optimize immune responses for cancer treatment or prevention.

trials.title: Chelator-guided radiosynthesis, preclinical evaluation, and clinical study of [68Ga]Ga-TRAP-(FAPI)3 for positron emission tomography imaging of tumors.
trials.summary: A new triple-molecule cancer imaging tracer shows superior tumor detection and accumulation compared to existing methods in liver cancer patients.

trials.title: Biomaterials-guided nanomedicine for familial adenomatous polyposis: lipid nanopartiscle RNA therapeutics with translational relevance.
trials.summary: Lipid nanoparticles delivering therapeutic mRNA successfully prevented intestinal tumors in mice with familial adenomatous polyposis, offering a promising genetic treatment approach.

trials.title: Biomineralized nanoemulsion delivers mRNA for potent cancer immunotherapy.
trials.summary: A new mRNA vaccine delivery system using manganese-modified nanoemulsions effectively treats cancer by activating immune responses better than existing platforms.

trials.title: Radiolabeled cyclic peptides in precision oncology: Current advances and future perspectives.
trials.summary: Radiolabeled cyclic peptides offer improved tumor targeting and stability for cancer imaging and treatment across multiple cancer types.

trials.title: Manganese-tannic acid immunomodulators potentiate PDGFRβ CAR-T cell function for additive therapy against liver fibrosis.
trials.summary: Manganese-tannic acid nanoparticles boost CAR-T cell therapy effectiveness against liver fibrosis by enhancing immune cell function.

trials.title: β-glucuronidase-triggered ortho-hydroxyl-mediated cyclization strategy for the efficient delivery of phenolic payloads in antibody-drug conjugates.
trials.summary: Researchers developed a new antibody-drug conjugate linker that efficiently delivers phenolic drugs to HER2-positive tumors, outperforming existing treatments.

trials.title: An injectable, dual-crosslinked polypeptide hydrogel encapsulating resiquimod-loaded nanoparticles as a long-lasting immunoprotective tumor vaccine.
trials.summary: Researchers developed an injectable hydrogel vaccine that slowly releases immune-stimulating drugs, recruiting immune cells to fight tumors and prevent cancer recurrence.

trials.title: Composite nanovesicles for enhanced chemodynamic cancer therapy via decitabine-mediated epigenetic reactivation.
trials.summary: Nanovesicles combining chemotherapy with a gene-reactivating drug boost immune response and kill breast cancer cells more effectively.

trials.title: Neoadjuvant Taxane Plus Trastuzumab and Pertuzumab With or Without Carboplatin in Human Epidermal Growth Factor Receptor 2-Positive Breast Cancer: The Randomized Noninferiority Phase III neoCARHP Trial.
trials.summary: Adding carboplatin to standard HER2-positive breast cancer treatment showed no benefit over treatment without it.
